Scrophulariaceae.key_door: modern narrow family; fused flower + superior usually 2-locular ovary/capsule, then genus-specific doors

Lentibulariaceae.key_door: carnivorous bladder trap + spurred bilabiate flower + 2 stamens

Paulowniaceae.key_door: huge opposite leaves + lavender tree flowers + woody capsule + numerous winged seeds

Martyniaceae.key_door: sticky glandular herb + bilabiate flower + two-horned devil's-claw fruit

lineage_lesson: Lamiales shares fused-corolla architecture, but family recognition becomes much stronger when fruit, parasitism/carnivory, growth habit, ovary structure and current genus placement are used instead of flower shape alone.
guardrails: Use current family circumscription rather than pre-molecular broad Scrophulariaceae.
Keep introduced Paulownia as comparison only.
